requirement:
删除独立的 SSO 登录注册模块，用统一的认证服务替代。
现有的 SSO、登录、注册三个独立服务维护成本高。
需要将认证逻辑统一到 auth 服务中，删除冗余服务。

details.name: ts-user-service
details.rationale: User service likely handles user profiles and may need to integrate with the unified auth service for authentication-related operations.

details.name: ts-security-service
details.rationale: Security service may contain authentication or authorization logic that needs to be consolidated into the auth service.

details.name: ts-gateway-service
details.rationale: Gateway service likely routes authentication requests and may need to update endpoints to point to the unified auth service.

details.name: ts-admin-user-service
details.rationale: Admin user service may manage user accounts and could be affected by changes in authentication flow.

details.name: ts-config-service
details.rationale: Config service may hold authentication-related configuration that needs to be updated for the unified auth service.

details.name: ts-basic-service
details.rationale: Basic service may provide common utilities or configuration that could be impacted by auth service changes.

details.name: ts-notification-service
details.rationale: Notification service may send auth-related emails (e.g., registration confirmation) and could need adjustments.

details.name: ts-preserve-other-service
details.rationale: Similar to preserve service, it may depend on authentication for other booking flows.

details.name: ts-rebook-service
details.rationale: Rebook service may require authentication for rebooking tickets and could be impacted.

details.name: ts-order-service
details.rationale: Order service may require user authentication for order management and could be impacted.

details.name: ts-order-other-service
details.rationale: Other order service may also depend on authentication for order-related operations.

details.name: ts-cancel-service
details.rationale: Cancel service may need user authentication to process cancellations and could be affected.

details.name: ts-preserve-service
details.rationale: Preserve service may rely on user authentication for booking operations and could be affected by auth changes.

details.name: ts-food-delivery-service
details.rationale: Food delivery service may depend on authentication for delivery tracking.
